confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Nagarkot, a hill resort village about 30 km east of Kathmandu. Restaurant and meal anchors are moderately certain. Hotel and guesthouse rates are less certain because they vary widely by season, weekend demand, mountain-view premiums, and resort versus guesthouse category. Drink prices are also uncertain, since draft beer is less common locally, so beer is estimated as a standard bottled serving. No live listings or booking pages were inspected.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on the Kathmandu Valley and Pokhara tourist-price tiers, with a hill-resort premium on accommodation and a remote-village premium on imported drinks, and budget guesthouse pricing for the dorm and basic-room anchors.
